label: Loss of epidermal miR-149 sensitizes to skin inflammation.
summary: Keratinocytes play a central role in amplifying skin inflammation in psoriasis and atopic dermatitis (AD). However, the epithelial-intrinsic regulators involved in responsiveness to inflammatory cues remain poorly defined. MiRNAs are fundamental regulators of gene expression. To define the role of miR-149 in keratinocyte immune functions in healthy skin and chronic inflammatory skin diseases.
